name: External Information Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the information type, as published in an external information type code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

INST.name: Processing Instructions
INST.definition: Instructions used to ease automatic request processing.

RELY.name: Relay Instructions
RELY.definition: Instructions used to ease automatic request relay.

SHPG.name: Shipping Information
SHPG.definition: Additional shipping information not otherwise specified.

SHPM.name: Shipping Marks
SHPM.definition: Information concerning the letters, numbers or other symbols placed on the outside of cargo to facilitate identification.

SLDC.name: Seller Domicile Location
SLDC.definition: Information concerning the domicile location of the seller.
